_comment: Unlock cards, loaded when the game starts. After a level is won, the player picks one of three cards
drawn from that side's pool (tower cards only once the Monsters side's last level has been beaten). Picks are permanent.
Every card: name, desc, effect, weight (how likely it is to be drawn), max (ranks; default 1), rare (gold
border; default false), plus what its effect needs.
Monster effects: type (makes `type` draftable), ability (unlocks `ability`; each extra rank cuts its
cooldown by 15%), buff (adds per_rank to monster modifier `mod`: hp, speed, burn, thaw), budget (adds
per_rank to the draft budget multiplier).
Tower effects: damage (per_rank more damage for towers of `line`; finals count for both parent lines),
range (per_rank more range), gold (per_rank more starting gold each Towers pass), lives (same for
lives), refund (per_rank more sell refund), detector (towers can target phased monsters), armor (adds
per_rank to the monster armor multiplier), grounding (adds per_rank to how long EMP and Smokescreen last).

swarmling.name: Swarmlings
swarmling.desc: Tiny, cheap, fast; they come in crowds

armored.name: Armored
armored.desc: Blocks part of every hit; shrugs off rapid fire

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.desc: Keeps slipping out of reach of targeting

warded.name: Warded
warded.desc: A ward absorbs one whole hit every 2.5 s

mirage.name: Mirage
mirage.desc: Casts illusions of itself that draw fire

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.desc: Gets faster as it's hurt: twice as fast near death

thawling.name: Thawling
thawling.desc: Sprints +80% for 2 s whenever a slow wears off

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.desc: When killed, towers next to it stop firing for 2 s

looter.name: Looter
looter.desc: Takes no lives: steals 15% of the defender's gold, or brings back 2x its cost

emp.name: EMP
emp.desc: Towers in an area stop firing for 3 s

smoke.name: Smokescreen
smoke.desc: Towers in an area lose 40% range for 6 s

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: Monsters take 50% less damage for 3 s

grounding.name: Grounding
grounding.desc: EMP and Smokescreen last half as long
